title: Prewarm id lookup terms blocks on relocation

target.summary: prepareSeekExact delegates directly to the underlying terms enum without checking the bloom filter with mayContainTerm. This bypasses the bloom filter during ID existence lookups, causing unnecessary disk/cache reads and severe indexing performance degradation.
notes: faulty statement delegating prepareSeekExact directly to delegate without checking bloom filter
definition of the prepareSeekExact method whose behavior is wrong
